Shop My Account Tours James Nash and Sophia Drapeau as Romeo and Juliet in our 2023 tour of R+J4evr Shakespeare on the Sound tours schools throughout Fairfield County every spring.
For the 2023-24 school year, we are offering a new tour for students grades 6-12.

For questions or to book a performance contact Nick Urda at nick@shakespeareonthesound.org ​ R+J 4EVR A 45-minute interactive play, followed by a 15-minute talk-back, that examines the relationship between Romeo and Juliet in a whole new way.
The play is appropriate for students in grades 6-12 Much Ado About Nothing for Kids A 30-minute interactive version of our season’s show appropriate for students in grades K-5.
This original play tours in late May and early June.
More Info Shakespeare on the Sound i s a proud member of the Shakespeare Theatre Association Where Shakespeare Lives Now!
